scope: Target-independent metadata candidates; retain all original values and rows. Counts refer only to TRAIN.

review_mileage_missing.meaning: No numeric mileage in source; existing model already has mileage_missing. Preserve missingness.

review_old_low_mileage.meaning: Unusually low advertised mileage on a car at least ten model-years old in the 2025 snapshot; possible restoration, reset, entry convention, or error. Not proof of falsification.

review_mileage_repeated_digits.definition: mileage_km is a nonnegative integer; its base-10 digits have length >= 3 and all equal
review_mileage_repeated_digits.meaning: An entry pattern worth review, including 555/777 and larger repeats. Not proof of a placeholder.

review_mileage_narrative_without_numeric.definition: mileage_km is NaN and desc contains regex \bпробег\w*\b (ignore case)
review_mileage_narrative_without_numeric.meaning: A mileage-related narrative exists but lacks a safely recoverable explicit numeric km field; do not infer current odometer from historical or unitless wording.

review_description_ellipsis.meaning: Visible truncation marker; omitted equipment/condition wording is unknown, so absence of a claim is not verified absence of equipment.

description_characters.meaning: Observed snippet coverage, not full description length.

review_train_attribute_collision.definition: Group size > 1 within TRAIN on brand, model, year, mileage_km, engine_liters_clean, fuel, body, transmission; group missing values together.
review_train_attribute_collision.meaning: Similar attribute records, not confirmed duplicate cars. Do not remove or use as model predictor.

review_train_attribute_and_description_c.definition: As above, also requiring identical desc.
review_train_attribute_and_description_c.meaning: Distinct ad IDs share visible attributes and snippet; mark for provenance review only. Not enough evidence for deduplication.

excluded: seller claims promoted to verified condition
modelling_note: No predictive benefit is claimed. Adding these columns to an enriched artifact is metadata work; using new predictors requires a separately frozen TRAIN-only validation protocol and no known-test tuning.
